'''''Dianthus lusitanus''''' is a species of ''[[Dianthus]]'' native to the [[Iberian Peninsula]], and to the Atlas Mountains of [[Morocco]] and [[Algeria]].<ref name = "153561-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:153561-1 |title=''Dianthus lusitanus'' Brot. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=18 August 2020 }}</ref> A hardy tussock-forming perennial growing on rocky slopes, in times past its numerous stems were used to make brooms.<ref>{{cite journal |last=Reuter |first=M. |date=1843 |title=Essai sur la Végétation de la Nouvelle Castille |journal=Mémoires de la Société de physique et d'histoire naturelle de Genève |volume=10 |pages=215–243 }}</ref> 
[[File:Clavel silvestre (planta) (44120430914).jpg|thumb|left|In its natural habitat]]
